startup_hook: Call source_reprocessing.initialize_admission(connection) in a write transaction after CaptureQueue construction and before first capture. Tick has idempotent fallback.
admission: New protocol gets operational highwater marker in existing cursor table; existing jobs, explicit requests/policy ranges and real context changes remain independent obligations.
legacy_proof: No old source audit receipt, immutable view version/check or completed derived frontier is rewritten to the new policy.
new_semantic_change_boundary: First actual assertion/edge/temporal/policy change may admit one whole-scope navigation classification when old pipeline is incompatible; no unproven classification compatibility or delta registry is introduced. Small personal-scope one-off classification was explicitly accepted; 100000-source navigation migration is not claimed incremental.
scale_evidence: 100000 completed historical raw/jobs, initialization+tick mutate only 2 operational cursor rows and enqueue none. This is an admission probe, not a full processing benchmark.
test_contract_updates: Pipeline-only change no longer automatically queues completed idle navigation.
Origin confirmation adds one actual source audit; future assistant intake can run without reauditing preceding source.
